title: Kundalini Yoga syllabus (Sivananda)
source: Sivananda, Kundalini Yoga (dlshq.org free reprint). Bhāvana over ratio; comfort rule throughout.
model: Grades with texts + body stations + guided visualizations + graduations (after sanskrithelp curriculum + Padoux §8 wiring).

grades.title: Grade 1 · Clear the channels
grades.text: Nadi-shodhana + svara chapters; 3-Om counts; no kumbhaka yet
grades.graduation: Easy alternate breathing 8 min, long exhales.

grades.title: Grade 2 · Six centres tour
grades.visual: ring at each centre + deity/bīja cue
grades.graduation: Name all six loci from feeling, in order.

grades.title: Grade 3 · Three knots
grades.graduation: Hold attention at each knot through one slow breath.

grades.title: Grade 4 · Ascent by bhāvana
grades.text: Kundalini ascent chapter; feel her rise chakra to chakra
grades.visual: rising pulse + whole-field suffusion + descent rest
grades.graduation: Sustain the full ascent visualization without the screen.

grades.title: Grade 5 · Lights and rest
grades.text: Experiences/lights chapter (pin-point → … → cloudless sky); curiosity only, no chasing
grades.graduation: Sit with whatever arises; report, don't chase.
